Leah (CEO): quick recap — Q3 focus: accelerate pipeline, partner enablement, Dedicated ramp. open to questions on sales/GTM/partners.
Mateo (VP Sales): q: are partner-sourced deals converting faster than direct? any numbers we can share?
Priya (Head of Partnerships): short answer: yes for mid-market. avg ACV ~2x and time-to-close ~20% faster vs blind inbound. will share aggregated deck after. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jordan (Product): can we clarify which partner motions get co-sell support vs referral? product needs that to prioritize integrations.
Priya (Head of Partnerships): co-sell = strategic partners (marketplaces, select SIs) where we do joint exec commits. referral = community/ISV partners w/ referral credits. posting partner-tier doc here: https://redwood.example.com/partners/tiering
Samir (GTM): pricing question — what's the guidance on discounts/commit for Dedicated deals? sales needs guardrails.
Mateo (VP Sales): standard guideline: 15% off list for 12mo commits. can go up to 25% with approval from revenue leader + CRO. margin-driven exceptions case-by-case. i'll update pricing playbook.
Maya (Ops): any change to lead routing? partner-sourced leads should route to AE + Partner rep. currently some are falling through.
Priya (Head of Partnerships): yes, new SFDC record type + workflow to route AE + Partner Lead. go-live next Tue. training session Wed 10am in GTM channel.
Alex (Sales Engineer): i'll prep the partner tech checklist and sample demo flows for Wed enablement.
Mateo (VP Sales): which KPIs will leadership track for partner program? helps us focus.
Leah (CEO): topline KPIs: partner-sourced ARR, time-to-first-deal, partner NPS, avg deal size, and % of pipeline influenced by partners. we'll expose partner KPIs in the Console dashboard soon.
Jordan (Product): product ask: prioritize partner onboarding API + partner metadata in calls.
Priya (Head of Partnerships): confirmed — oauth onboarding + partner metadata fields are highest priority from partners.
Jordan (Product): rough ETA: we can ship basic partner metadata fields in v1.5 (two sprints) and incremental onboarding improvements in v1.6.
Mateo (VP Sales): action item: Mateo + Priya + Jordan to sync to define contractual language, SLAs, and pricing bands. Samir, please coordinate the agenda for commercial alignment.
Samir (GTM): on it. will set a 30-min sync and drop notes in #gtm and link in this thread.
Leah (CEO): thanks all. one quick follow-up: please upvote blockers in the all-hands doc (link below) so we can prioritize. will post summary & next-steps by Friday. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example
Maya (Ops): :thumbsup: thanks, will attend Wed training.
Priya (Head of Partnerships): i'll publish the partner enablement pack and partner contact sheet after the sync.
Leah (CEO): appreciate the questions — we'll close loop on actions and publish a short GTM checklist for partners this week.
